nodes.statement:
∃ Cd Ck : ℝ, 0 < Cd ∧ 0 < Ck ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 →
        ∃ θ : ℚ, ε / 2 < (θ : ℝ) ∧ (θ : ℝ) < ε ∧
          (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension (θ : ℝ) : ℝ) ≤ Cd * ε⁻¹ ^ 2 ∧
          (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity (θ : ℝ) : ℝ) ≤ Ck * ε⁻¹ ^ 6 ∧
          ∃ g : ∀ n, ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Geometry (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension (θ : ℝ)) n,
            ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.EfficientFamily ε (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity (θ : ℝ)) (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension (θ : ℝ)))
              (fun n => ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.sampleLaw (θ : ℝ) n (g n)) (fun n => ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rankTest (θ : ℝ) (g n)) ∧
            Filter.Tendsto (fun n => Real.log (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension (θ : ℝ)) n) / Real.log n -
              2 * (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension (θ : ℝ) : ℝ) ^ 2) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
nodes.proof_route: Choose the rational parameter with the proved absolute constants. Obtain one coherent geometry family with actual sampler/tester implementations. Intersect the eventual growth, row-weight, expansion, adversarial and uniform-test guarantees; take a maximum of their thresholds and retain the exact runtime and law clauses. Append the proved logarithmic stretch limit. Only the explicitly registered computational, expansion and uniform-rank probability branches remain unresolved.

children.purpose: Selects rational θ with ε-independent d/k bounds.
children.proof_route: Choose a rational between ε/2 and ε, bound the two exact ceilings, and compare inverse powers to retain constants independent of ε.
children.strictly_useful: Selects rational θ with ε-independent d/k bounds.

children.purpose: Constructs actual finite sampler and tester programs with exact law and polynomial time, on one coherent geometry family.
children.proof_route: Construct a coherent finite-field representation from irreducible binary polynomials, exact uniform-bit sampling of forms/hashes, and finite Gaussian elimination; compile bounded counter programs into the actual NKtLB transition tables with a polynomial time proof. This entire computational obligation remains explicitly open.
children.strictly_useful: Constructs actual finite sampler and tester programs with exact law and polynomial time, on one coherent geometry family.

children.purpose: Discharges n<m<n^k for the exact deterministic row count.
children.proof_route: Use n^(2d)≤q<2n^(2d), raise to d, and use the exact ceiling arity to obtain 2d²+1≤k. Absorb fixed 2^d into n eventually.
children.strictly_useful: Discharges n<m<n^k for the exact deterministic row count.

children.purpose: Counts the exact selected neighbor in every disjoint layer.
children.proof_route: Identify PMF support with actual combined outputs; each layer has a distinct column in its disjoint bucket block, and n≥arity implies arity*buckets≤n.
children.strictly_useful: Counts the exact selected neighbor in every disjoint layer.

children.purpose: Accepts every bounded-weight error on every sampler output.
children.proof_route: Use exact PMF support to recover sampled forms/hashes, apply canonical codeword annihilation to bound rank by error weight, and compare ε and θ thresholds.
children.strictly_useful: Accepts every bounded-weight error on every sampler output.

children.purpose: Proves the exact sampler success probability using collision and hash estimates.
children.proof_route: Peel collision-light rows, count deterministic active candidates via Vandermonde uniqueness, union-bound independent random-form collisions, bound independent hash occupancy, then transfer little-o bounds using θ<ε. Finite counting and analytic tails remain open.
children.strictly_useful: Proves the exact sampler success probability using collision and hash estimates.

children.purpose: Proves the exact external ε exponent for the uniform rank test.
children.proof_route: Use exact Reed-Muller rate/erasure limits, restriction rank-nullity and Sylvester to lower-bound expected rank; apply the proved sharp bounded-differences theorem. Keep θ>ε/2 slack to preserve the exact final exponent. Rate interval and affine invariance remain open.
children.strictly_useful: Proves the exact external ε exponent for the uniform rank test.

children.purpose: Identifies the exact polynomial stretch exponent.
children.proof_route: Use the exact polynomial lower/upper row-count bounds, take logarithms, and squeeze the error between zero and d*log(2)/log(n).
children.strictly_useful: Identifies the exact polynomial stretch exponent.

∀ (ε : ℝ), (0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 / 2) →
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ∀ (g : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Geometry (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n)
      (s : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Forms g.F (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity ε))
      (h : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Hashes g.F (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity ε) (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.buckets ε n)) (x : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Word n),
      ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.testMatrix g ((ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.combined g s h).mulVec x) = 0 ∧
      ∀ e : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Word (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n),
        (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.testMatrix g ((ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.combined g s h).mulVec x + e)).rank ≤ ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.weight e

      ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.uniformProb (fun y : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Word (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n) => ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rankTest ε g y = true) ≤
        Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2 / 32) * ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n) ∧
      ∀ (s : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Forms g.F (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity ε))
        (h : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Hashes g.F (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity ε) (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.buckets ε n)) (x : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Word n),
        (∀ e : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Word (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n),
          (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.weight e : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2 - ε) * ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n →
          ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rankTest ε g ((ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.combined g s h).mulVec x + e) = true) ∧
        (∑ e : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Word (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n),
          ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.bernoulliWord (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n) (1 / 2 - ε) e *
            (if ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rankTest ε g ((ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.combined g s h).mulVec x + e) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) ≥
          1 - Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2 / 2) * ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n)

Normalize weighted L^(4/3) norm to one; away from constants use strict Jensen and compactness, near constants use the uniformly positive second-order gap (exponent 4/3). More concretely, divide the Jensen gap ((E|f|^(4/3))^(3/2)−(Ef)^2) by Var(f) on the compact unit sphere away from constants. The ratio has positive limit 1/3 at either constant ±1, uniformly for p in the compact interval. Any positive lower bound on this ratio supplies r².

Normalize weighted L^(4/3) norm to one; away from constants use strict Jensen and compactness, near constants use the uniformly positive second-order gap (exponent 4/3). Compact p∈[a,b] gives one r>0. This is only an inequality in two real variables and has no code, event, dimension, transitivity, derivative, or asymptotic assumptions. More concretely, divide the Jensen gap ((E|f|^(4/3))^(3/2)−(Ef)^2) by Var(f) on the compact unit sphere away from constants. The ratio has positive limit 1/3 at either constant ±1, uniformly for p in the compact interval. Any positive lower bound on this ratio supplies r².

nodes.proof_route: Represent each exact canonical exponent vector by Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm and its coefficient-one MvPolynomial monomial. The map from canonical indices to exponent Finsupp is injective, so basisMonomials gives linear independence of the polynomial family. Every exponent coordinate is below card F, so its span lies in restrictDegree (card F-1). MvPolynomial.eq_zero_of_eval_eq_zero makes evaluation injective there; a variable-only ULift rename handles Mathlib's equal-universe restriction without restricting F. Map polynomial independence through evalₗ, identify evaluation with exact monomialEval, and apply finrank_span_eq_card to exact reedMuller.

Coordinatewise floors give the lower inclusion of the halfspace at R/q, after null upper faces are removed; summing box upper bounds gives the upper inclusion in the halfspace at (R+d)/q. nodes.proof_route: Use exact integer division inequalities to bound auxiliaryDegree(q,d)/q between (d-3)/2-d/q and (d-3)/2. Prove the coordinate-sum level set is a proper affine subspace and hence Lebesgue null. Dominated indicator convergence yields continuity of the actual cube-halfspace volume in its threshold. Partition the half-open unit cube into pairwise disjoint boxes [a_i/q,(a_i+1)/q). Their selected union has exact Lebesgue volume card(GridIndices)/q^d. Coordinatewise floors give the lower inclusion of the halfspace at R/q, after null upper faces are removed; summing box upper bounds gives the upper inclusion in the halfspace at (R+d)/q. Both thresholds converge to the same target, so real-valued volume squeeze proves the moving-degree natural-count limit. Finally apply the independently proved exact finite Reed--Muller dimension equality and fieldSize growth, preserving arbitrary mission Geometry choices and the exact rowCount denominator.

∀ (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 / 2),
∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ∀ g : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Geometry (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n,
      ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.uniformProb (fun y : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Word (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n) => ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rankTest ε g y = true) ≤
        Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2 / 32) * ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n) ∧
      ∀ (s : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Forms g.F (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity ε))
        (h : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Hashes g.F (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity ε) (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.buckets ε n)) (x : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Word n),
        (∀ e : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Word (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n),
          (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.weight e : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2 - ε) * ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n →
          ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rankTest ε g ((ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.combined g s h).mulVec x + e) = true) ∧
        (∑ e : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Word (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n),
          ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.bernoulliWord (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n) (1 / 2 - ε) e *
            (if ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rankTest ε g ((ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.combined g s h).mulVec x + e) then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) ≥
          1 - Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2 / 2) * ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension ε) n)

nodes.proof_route: For positive exponent n reduce to 1+(n-1)%(q-1), preserving zero separately. Fermat's identity preserves evaluation and reduced exponent is ≤n and <q. Expand arbitrary polynomial into support monomials. Each reduced exponent vector is a canonical Monomials F d R index, so each evaluated term and their finite sum belongs canonical reedMuller. For canonical generator compose with affine scalar forms and bound total degree by sum of generator exponents. Extend by Submodule.span_induction. Extend a linear equivalence between spans of two nonzero difference vectors to a full linear automorphism, then translate to obtain affine pair transitivity. Use exact coordinate linear equivalence c ↦ c∘rowOrder. Prove ambiguity reindex equality and finite erasure-expectation reindex identity, then apply canonical erasure_ambiguity to Fin(rowCount). Apply the already proved exact erasure_ambiguity to the reindexed auxiliary code, rowCount length growth, and tendsto_auxiliaryCode_rate; transfer erasureExpectation back along rowOrder. Canonical capacity and exact rate convergence are separately recorded closed dependencies.

      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => δ n * (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / ε)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧

        ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.uniformProb (fun h : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Hashes (g n).F (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity ε) (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.buckets ε n) =>
          ¬ ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Expanding (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.combined (g n) s h) (1 - ε) (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity ε) ((n : ℝ) ^ (1 - ε))) ≤ δ n
